observations.evidence: src/manager/ui/manager-app.tsx and src/manager/services.ts have no write-request list, detail, or approval surface.
src/broker/write-request-admin.ts provides workspace/status filtering and approve/reject routes backed by WriteRequestService; approval revalidates through the broker-owned service.
GET /admin/write-requests supports workspaceId and optional worktreeId; omitting worktreeId covers all worktree targets for that workspace.

WriteRequestService.listRequests() and getRequest() call expireAndPruneLocked(), so Manager polling/inspection needs a non-mutating broker-owned projection to preserve its observational-read contract.
User reports reviewing pending requests daily and wants request presence visible on workspace rows.
